scope: Source inspection inventory, not deployment/configuration evidence or authority to connect services.
qualification_rule: No destination or scope is allowed by this inventory. Pin exact destination, minimum scopes, retention/deletion commitments, current company consent and revocation semantics before qualifying a real-data connection. Observed adapter code does not prove configured or connected service.

data_categories: email address for explicit user lookup
authentication/session request data and client network metadata
services.fallback: Reauthenticate; preserve saved accounting work. Revocation must reconcile external identity with company membership; do not infer company authority from identity alone.

operation_boundary: Suggestions, explanations, reminder drafts and insights only; no AI authority to post, allocate, file or send
This inventory describes code capable of outbound transmission; it does not establish actual configuration, current consent, retention or allowlisting
data_categories: Caller-provided chat prompts/messages, including any financial or personal data supplied by the caller
Server-generated bank transaction identifiers, descriptions, references, dates, directions and amounts
Company chart account names supplied as available categorisation choices
Reconciliation scenarios, statuses, matched totals, remaining amounts, matched record numbers/names/amounts
Company and customer names, invoice number, due date, outstanding balance and requested reminder tone
Company monthly revenue and supplier spend, overdue/outstanding invoice counts and totals, unreconciled transaction counts
Company pending transaction-review counts grouped by state, possible duplicates, VAT review and high-priority counts
services.fallback: Keep user work locally/server-side; show unavailable assistance and continue manual accounting. Do not silently switch models/providers or resend unknown outcomes.

outbound_payloads.bounds: Up to 25 transactions per call; chart names included in system prompt. Optional caller invocation does not itself establish consent.
Optional explanation for single-transaction mode; matched names may identify customer/supplier counterparties.
Draft text generation only. Customer email is returned to the application but is not a field in this completion payload; no email send is performed by the AI call.
Aggregated company financial figures, not anonymous public data; still require outbound-data qualification.

fields: caller prompt or accepted user/assistant/system messages
outbound_payloads.bounds: askAI adds company review counts derived from up to 100 pending analyses. Diagnostic completion can transmit caller prompt. User messages may themselves contain additional sensitive data.

services.fallback: Retain original document and extraction job identity; manual transcription remains available. No accounting posting from extraction.
Preserve imported observations and review identities; manual file import must retain duplicate provenance. No money movement authority.

operation_boundary: Direct HMRC interface within actual filing authority
services.fallback: Unknown filing outcome requires original submission recovery; never automatic resubmission/new identity or false filed status.

data_categories: Explicitly selected message, attachment and recipient data
services.fallback: Preserve draft/source; no silent send or broader mailbox permission. Unknown sends require original operation recovery.

remaining: Inspect all deployment-specific configured destinations and SDK overrides without exposing credentials.
Verify actual contractual retention/deletion terms; do not infer provider defaults.
Integrate validated policy at each outbound adapter and exercise real isolated expiry/outage/revocation acceptance.
Qualify hosting/database/storage/telemetry boundaries and any newly discovered external services.
